question: Will the top 3 trade schools in the US post a collective enrollment growth of 10% or more between 2026 and 2029?
resolution_criteria: The top 3 trade schools - WyoTech, Northwood Technical College, Concorde Career College-Garden Grove, post a collective enrollment growth rate of at least 10% as measured by their official reported enrollment numbers at the end of 2029 baselined at 2026.
